descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații și Testare și evaluare sisteme IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Test Automation Engineer who is eager to contribute to building high-quality software solutions, drive innovation in testing practices, and continuously improve automation frameworks in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
 What you will do: 
 • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web, mobile, and API applications
 • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and QA teams to ensure comprehensive test coverage
 • Integrate AI-powered testing tools to improve efficiency and defect detection
 • Analyze test results, identify root causes, and support issue resolution
 • Continuously evaluate and adopt new automation and AI/ML-based testing solutions
 • Develop and maintain test data, environments, and documentation
 • Participate in code reviews and contribute to QA best practices
 • Monitor and report on test execution, coverage, and quality metrics
 • Review software specifications and testing procedures
 • Create, update, and execute automated test scripts
 What you need to have: 
 • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or similar field
 • Strong programming skills in Python (3+ years of experience)
 • Good analytical skills for complex problem solving
 • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks
 • Experience with version control systems (preferably Git)
 • Experience in development, debugging, and troubleshooting
 • Good understanding of Embedded Systems and Automotive products
 • Understanding of software and hardware architecture across platforms
 • Knowledge of Telematics domains (OTA, GNSS, E-Call, 4G/5G, WiFi, V2X, Remote Services, Security)
 • Experience with test methods, processes, and tools
 • Knowledge of communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet)
 • Understanding of diagnostic communication in electronic control units
 • Familiarity with V-model development process
 • Understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation
 • Familiarity with AI-powered tools (automation, data analysis, etc.)
 • Strong team player mindset with a proactive attitude
 Nice to have: 
 • ISTQB certification and ASPICE knowledge
 • Experience with Python frameworks such as Robot or PyCharm-based environments
 • Hands-on experience with automation scripting in Python
 • Experience with tools such as Jira or IBM toolsets
 • Experience working in Agile/SCRUM environments
 • Hardware experience with different test setups
 • Knowledge of ALM tools
 What is in it for you: 
 • Extended compensation and benefits package
 • Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
 • A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
 • Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
 • Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
 • Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams
 Interested or know someone who might be a great fit? Feel free to reach out or apply.
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
